description: Reads one analysis_results payload for a run and analysis_type.
signature: def read_analysis_result(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, analysis_type: str) -> dict | None
docstring:
Read one analysis result blob.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to read.
    analysis_type: One of the seven allowed analysis_type values.

Returns:
    The deserialized payload dict, or None if no row exists for that (run_id, analysis_type) pair (e.g. the analysis stage has not run yet, or failed before writing this particular result type).
postconditions: Returns None rather than raising for a missing (run_id, analysis_type) pair
The returned dict is a fresh deserialization each call (mutating the returned dict never affects the stored row)

edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns None (same as a known run missing that analysis_type; storage does not distinguish 'run does not exist' from 'result not yet computed' at this call -- reporting.load_run_report is responsible for that distinction using get_run)
no effect on the stored payload_json; a second read_analysis_result call returns the original, unmutated content

unit_tests.name: test_read_existing_result
unit_tests.description: A result written via write_analysis_result is read back identically.

unit_tests.name: test_missing_result_returns_none
unit_tests.description: An analysis_type never written for this run returns None.

unit_tests.name: test_mutation_of_returned_dict_does_not_persist
unit_tests.description: Mutating the returned dict and re-reading shows the original content.
unit_tests.expected: second read equals the originally written payload
